build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with potentials and transitions graphs using gen_model
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a CRF with a given number of classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph mapping features to classes for a CRF
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a trained linear-chain CRF model using viterbi decoding
compute_crf_loss: compute the negative log-likelihood loss for a CRF given input and target sequences
